title: Find a booking as a guest
caption: `tools/e2e/specs/storefront/account-bookings.e2e.ts` (last two tests) and `src/pages/lookup.js`.

steps.title: Open the lookup in a fresh browser
steps.expect: "Find your booking" with Booking reference and Last name; below it "Sign in" to My bookings (only with customer accounts).

steps.title: Wrong name, then wrong reference
steps.body: Correct reference + wrong last name; then a wrong reference + correct name.
steps.expect: Both show exactly "We could not find a booking with these details" with neither field marked and the typed values kept.

steps.title: Correct details
steps.body: Reference (lower case or with spaces is fine) + any traveller's last name; **Find my booking**.
steps.expect: `/booking.html?id=bkg_…` opens. DB: `booking_access_tokens` row `issued_via = 'lookup'`; `booking_events` `booking.lookup`; cookie `__Host-vx_bt` gains an entry.

steps.title: Too many attempts
steps.expect: "Too many attempts, try again in N minutes" and the button disabled until the wait ends, then "You can try again now". Redis: `rl:ota_lookup_ip:*` and `rl:ota_lookup_reference:*` keys.
